description: Lists the drafts in a Gmail mailbox. Returns one entry per draft with its draft ID, the ID of the message it holds and that message's thread ID, plus a count and a page token when more drafts remain. The draft ID is what gmail_update_draft, gmail_send_draft and gmail_delete_draft take; the message ID is what gmail_read takes to show the draft's content. A mailbox with no drafts answers with a count of 0 and an empty list.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

max_results.description: The most drafts to return in one page (default: 20, at most 500).

page_token.description: The nextPageToken from an earlier call, to read the page after it.

query.description: Narrows the list to drafts matching a Gmail search query, in the same syntax as gmail_search (for example "subject:invoice" or "to:someone@example.com").

name: gws-mcp__gmail_list_drafts
